tasks.short: Prepare for campus or community participation and keep practical follow-up separate from the event.

steps.what: Retrieve campus and community event details and the requested contribution
Clarify the teacher's role and practical arrangements with event organisers
Write the personal event preparation notes and record practical commitments
Participate in the campus or community event and engage with participants
Record useful contacts, personal follow-up actions and event learning points

tasks.design: Use native event links and personal preparation layouts in {CALENDAR} and {DOCS}. Clarification, live participation, pre-event commitments and post-event notes remain separate steps; no automatic organiser message or public presentation is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Event details and personal preparation and follow-up notes are repeatedly arranged.
tasks.enabler_now: Native event links and short reusable note layouts can reduce clerical handling.
tasks.still_hard: Meaningful community engagement and adapting to the event.
tasks.human_edge: Presence and reciprocal relationships with participants.
tasks.altitude: Keep participation personal with less repeated note handling.

reach.task: Locate the teacher's agreed event contribution

evidence.claim: Native event links and preparation templates may reduce existing personal administration; this is an E1 scenario.

assumptions: The baseline includes existing personal event preparation and follow-up notes, separately from participation. It does not add responsibility for running or reporting the whole event.

The organiser supplies event identity, time and location; the teacher verifies these in s1, captures personal commitments in s3 and actual follow-up in s5. Capture time is counted; missing details are clarified manually.
Native calendar and note features are tested first. No invitation dispatch, public content publication or automatic contact creation is implied.
Ordinary author saves remain fully retained without self-approval. Notes are proportionate working notes, not a new mandatory report after every event.
unknowns: Actual frequency and extent of personal preparation notes
Existing event links and calendar features
research_questions: Do observed events contain repeated personal reference and note handling that native layouts can reduce?

already_counted.description: Preparation and later follow-up note entry

incremental.description: Maintain event note layouts and links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R94 gives6 gross minus1 upkeep =5 net. Low: event invitations lack stable references and preparation is bespoke, leaving lookup10, preparation10 and follow-up9 plus70 unchanged, R99; net0. High: event links work but commitments and follow-up wording remain individual, leaving9+9+8+70=96 retained; net3 after1 upkeep. Clarification and live participation stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select specialized readings and compile a verified, correctly formatted bibliography.

steps.what: Define the outside reading assignment's topic, level and selection criteria
Search catalogues and verified sources for specialized materials
Assess relevance, quality and accessibility and select the specialized readings
Capture selected title, author, edition, publication year and persistent reference metadata
Compile bibliographies from the verified metadata in the required citation style
Check citations, editions and access links and retain the prepared bibliography

tasks.design: Configure catalogue searches and metadata capture in {OTHER}, the reference manager, then use its native citation-style formatting in {DOCS}. Reading selection and source verification remain human, with a separate final bibliography check; no generative title suggestion is needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated searches, bibliographic metadata entry and manual citation formatting consume effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue imports and citation styles can reuse verified bibliographic records.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting material that is relevant, credible and accessible at the students' level.
tasks.human_edge: Academic judgement about the value of a particular reading.
tasks.altitude: Curate the reading selection rather than repeatedly type and format references.

reach.task: Prepare a reliable specialized reading list

evidence.claim: Scopus AI provides topic summaries and foundational papers, supporting discovery; final selection and reference verification remain separate.
Native reference metadata capture and citation formatting may reduce manual handling; the labour estimate is E1.

assumptions: The task includes selecting and compiling the bibliography. No distribution or second-system rekey is silently assumed.

The teacher supplies scope and level in s1, selects actual works in s3 and captures or verifies author, title, edition, year and persistent identifier in s4. Capture is counted; missing metadata is entered manually from the source.
The teacher selects citation style while defining the assignment in s1. S5 consumes that style and the verified s4 metadata; incompatible styles require manual formatting.

Test native reference features first. Existing automatic formatting earns no new saving if no current human formatting work exists; ordinary author saves remain fully retained in s6 without self-approval.
unknowns: Completeness of catalogue metadata and required style compatibility
research_questions: Can native metadata capture and formatting reduce total compilation time after edition and access checks?

already_counted.description: Academic reading selection and final citation checks

incremental.description: Maintain search filters and citation-style settings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R76.5 gives23.5 gross minus3 upkeep =20.5 net. Low: specialized editions lack metadata and the required style needs manual correction, leaving search24, metadata19 and formatting7 plus45 unchanged, R95; net2. High: identifiers are available but some nonstandard materials need manual citation work, leaving search21, metadata17 and formatting1 plus45 unchanged, R84; net13 after3 upkeep. Reading selection and final checks stay full.

tasks.short: Analyse a client's geography problem, write the advice and separately deliver the consulting result.

steps.what: Clarify the government or industry client's consulting question and scope
Retrieve relevant geographic evidence, source documents and client records
Analyse the evidence and determine the professional consulting advice
Write the consulting report with evidence, recommendations and limitations

loop.purpose: Draft the report from the consultant's chosen advice
loop.input: Professional findings, recommendations, verified sources and scope
loop.output: Draft report distinguishing evidence, interpretation and limitations
loop.check: Consultant checks every conclusion and geographic claim against the supplied evidence and intended advice
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported claims, scope changes or confidential material require manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: A report template cannot express the case-specific explanation and limitations

steps.what: Check and revise the consulting report's evidence, advice and scope
Check the final consulting report and send it to the client
Check and present the professional advice and answer the client's questions

tasks.design: Use source views in {OTHER}, the geographic analysis and reference software, with bounded report drafting in {DOCS}. Professional analysis and revision stay human; sending the final report through {EMAIL} and explaining it to the client are separate actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source navigation and first-draft report wording add time around professional analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source organisation and reviewed drafting can reuse the consultant's chosen findings.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting defensible advice for the client's actual situation.
tasks.human_edge: Professional judgement, accountability and understanding the client's constraints.
tasks.altitude: Spend more consulting attention on evidence and client understanding.

reach.task: Prepare a traceable geographic advice pack

evidence.claim: Source-linked consulting report drafting is a plausible E1 capability; the digest provides no measured geography consulting case.

assumptions: The task includes scope discussion, analysis, the report write and actual client delivery. Client decision-making is not counted as the teacher's saving.

The consultant captures scope in s1, verifies source identities in s2 and creates findings and recommendations in s3. These are the only draft inputs; missing or incompatible geographic evidence requires manual analysis.
Native report templates and source views precede the loop. No automatic geographic inference, external dataset transfer or additional publication is implied.
Ordinary author saves remain fully retained without self-approval; gates apply to the exact report send and presentation.
unknowns: Actual output format and need for bespoke maps
research_questions: Does a reviewed first draft reduce total report effort while preserving the consultant's findings and limitations?

already_counted.description: Report draft review and full professional revision

incremental.description: Maintain report templates and source-grounded drafting checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact final report, attachments and client recipients checked before sending; any change voids approval.
Exact findings and recommendations to be presented to the intended client checked before delivery; changed claims require a fresh check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R87 gives13 gross minus3 upkeep =10 net. Low: client records have incompatible spatial references and most report prose needs rewriting, leaving retrieval14 and writing22 plus60 unchanged, R96; net1. High: evidence identifiers align but recommendation wording stays bespoke, leaving13+18+60=91 retained; net6 after3 upkeep. Analysis, final revision and client delivery stay full.

tasks.short: Advise student organizations and separately write and share useful follow-up guidance.

steps.what: Clarify the student organization's question, objectives and current circumstances
Retrieve relevant campus guidance and earlier organisation action notes
Act as adviser, explore options and help students judge their next actions
Write the advising record and practical follow-up guidance
Check the final guidance and share it with the student leaders

tasks.design: Configure campus guidance links and a short advising and action layout in {DOCS}. The student conversation stays human; writing the actual follow-up and sharing its final version through {EMAIL} are separate steps, with no extra power to approve the organization's decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Earlier guidance and recurring action headings are repeatedly located and written.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked references and reusable follow-up structures can reduce mechanical preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Helping students make their own sound decisions and manage group relationships.
tasks.altitude: Maintain clearer continuity between student-organisation advising conversations.

reach.learn: Relevant action references and student ownership

evidence.claim: Native guidance links and advising templates may reduce existing record handling; this is an E1 scenario.

assumptions: The baseline includes the actual written advising record and follow-up, separately from discussion. It does not invent an approval or formal report that the adviser does not normally provide.

Student leaders supply the question in s1; the adviser identifies current guidance in s2 and captures agreed actions and references in s4. Capture time is counted, and unclear responsibilities are clarified manually.
Native templates are sufficient before custom software. The design reuses headings and standard references while retaining case-specific advice; no generated student decision is assumed.
Ordinary author saves remain fully retained without self-approval. The gate applies only to sharing the final guidance.
unknowns: Actual written follow-up frequency and effort
Existing campus guidance and advising template availability
research_questions: Which repeated record fields and guidance references can native templates reduce without shortening student discussion?

incremental.description: Maintain campus guidance links and follow-up layouts

approvals.approved_version: Exact final guidance text, attachments and student leader recipients checked before sharing; any change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R90.75 gives9.25 gross minus2 upkeep =7.25 net. Low: current guidance has inconsistent versions and follow-up is mostly bespoke, leaving retrieval15 and writing23 plus60 unchanged, R98; net0. High: guidance links and action headings fit but advice remains individual, leaving13+21+60=94 retained; net4 after2 upkeep. Both conversations and the actual guidance share stay full.

reach: Prepare traceable consulting and advising follow-up
